review.use_summary: Excluded candidate human substitutions overlapping low-complexity, simple and satellite RepeatMasker regions downloaded from UCSC, alongside separate TRF and ENCODE region filters.
review.implementation_scope_note: This is reuse of repeat annotations, not evidence of running RepeatMasker. Keep the UCSC resource/build and class definitions explicit; genotype-frequency filters and sequence-synthesis constraints are separate.

review.use_summary: Intersected amplicon junction coordinates with TA/AT-rich repeats from the UCSC RepeatMasker track using BEDTools 2.31.1 and each dataset's hg19 or hg38 reference.
review.implementation_scope_note: The motif examples do not define a complete selection rule or junction-to-BED projection. RepeatMasker search execution is not reported; require explicit motif/resource/build and interval choices rather than guessing them.

review.use_summary: Scanned extended variant alleles with RepeatMasker 4.1.2-p1 using -species human -gff -s -norna -nolow, then classified mobile elements with inclusive 75% consensus and variant-coverage thresholds.
review.implementation_scope_note: The six-type classification and complete/fragment labels are downstream operations. The reference library release, grouping of split insertion records and overlap/extent conventions require review; do not substitute current4.2.6 or treat -nolow as merely an output-row filter.

review.use_summary: Used HOMER with UCSC mm10 refGene and RepeatMasker annotations to annotate transposable-element overlap at cCREs before separate mixture-model analyses.
review.implementation_scope_note: The paragraph supports annotation reuse, not a new RepeatMasker search. HOMER annotation and R mixtools2.0.0 model P-values are separate; import the exact resources and declare overlap and subclass definitions.

review.use_summary: Annotated plant-genome repeats with RepeatMasker 4.0.9 using -e rmblast -div 40 -norna after RepeatModeler2.0.1 repeat identification and classification.
review.implementation_scope_note: MAKER2, protein-coding gene prediction and transcript assembly are separate. Retain the generated repeat library and the exact historical engine/software choices; printed divergence values do not expose all internal search precision.

review.use_summary: Used RepeatMasker 4.1.2 for homology-based TE annotation across29haplotypes with nonredundant repeat catalogs built using RepeatModeler2.0.4 and EDTA2.0.1.
review.implementation_scope_note: Library generation, catalog combination and gene annotation are separate operations. Full RepeatMasker flags and exact library construction are unstated; a supplied-library workflow requires explicit provenance and assembly declarations.

review.use_summary: Generated repeat annotations for species lacking them by mapping RepeatModeler2.0.2a consensus repeat libraries against genomes using RepeatMasker4.1.2-p1.
review.implementation_scope_note: RepeatModeler2 included its LTR-finding module and is separate from RepeatMasker. Species with existing annotations are not automatically new search runs; complete flags and resource releases remain unspecified.

review.use_summary: Used RepeatMasker4.1.5 with the default Dfam library in Mus musculus mode to annotate repeats in T2T mouse assemblies, including centromeric repeats supporting placement of unplaced telomeric contigs.
review.implementation_scope_note: Methods paragraph40 resolves the version/species/default-Dfam choice, but not the exact Dfam release. Targeted BLAST validation, Hi-C/MashMap placement and manual assembly curation remain separate; an official bundled Dfam3.7 resource does not establish the study's exact library identity.

prior_review.use_summary: Annotated centromeric repeats in candidate unplaced telomeric contigs to support their placement in missing chromosome regions.
prior_review.implementation_scope_note: The exact upstream method, reference inputs and assembly curation decisions remain pending; native sequence transformations alone do not implement this workflow.

review.use_summary: Masked plant genomes with RepeatMasker4.1.1 using an EDTA-fragment library whose unknown TE sequences were classified with TERL, then merged and deduplicated annotations to obtain TE annotations and softmasked assemblies.
review.implementation_scope_note: The softmasked product is described for the combined workflow; the exact RepeatMasker masking flag and merge rules are not provided. EDTA and TERL inference remain separate and the library provenance must be explicit.

review.use_summary: Masked simple repeats in Y-chromosome assemblies with RepeatMasker4.1.5 before separate tandem-repeat masking with TRF4.09 and progressiveMauve alignment for clock-model comparisons.
review.implementation_scope_note: The paragraph does not specify -noint or its repeat library. TRF, multiple alignment, window/gap filtering, tree-puzzle likelihood tests and R multiple-testing correction are separate; do not infer their settings as RepeatMasker options.

review.use_summary: Annotated genome repeats using RepeatMasker4.1.2-p1 with homology evidence from RepBase20180823 after RepeatModeler2.0.3 library construction; downstream gene annotation filtered transcripts overlapping repeats by more than20%.
review.implementation_scope_note: The exact library combination and RepeatMasker flags are not given. RepBase requires an appropriately licensed local resource; RepeatModeler, gene prediction and strict transcript-overlap filtering remain separate. Transcript span versus exon-union denominators are not specified.
